title: Untitled (moonlit palette-knife oil painting)
model_requested: Qwen-Image (Alibaba Qwen), model name "Qwen-Image_fp8" on AI Horde
service: AI Horde (aihorde.net), a volunteer GPU network, anonymous API key (no account); a community worker ran the job
prompt: an expressive palette-knife oil painting at night, thick impasto in indigo and silver, a cold moon, the black ruined iron pier skeleton, visible knife marks, oil on canvas
settings: resolution 1024x768, seed 1, 20 steps, k_euler, CFG 4 (fp8 build), denoising strength 0.72, worker tazlin-larger-machine-2; native output 1024x768, stored as JPEG q92
terms_note: AI Horde states that it claims no rights in generated outputs; the model is Apache 2.0, which places no restriction on outputs. Anonymous text-to-image jobs on AI Horde are shared with LAION by its terms; image-to-image jobs are not. Made by image-to-image from Photograph of the ruined West Pier by CGP Grey, 2005, CC BY 2.0 (No. 20 in this gallery, from Wikimedia Commons), redrawn by an image model, so the gallery cannot dedicate it to the public domain: it is shared under the same licence as the photograph (CC BY 2.0), with credit to the photographer. Fabricated painting: nothing in it was ever painted, drawn or printed by hand.

ref.credit: Photograph of the ruined West Pier by CGP Grey, 2005, CC BY 2.0 (No. 20 in this gallery, from Wikimedia Commons), redrawn by an image model

source_credit: Photograph of the ruined West Pier by CGP Grey, 2005, CC BY 2.0 (No. 20 in this gallery, from Wikimedia Commons), redrawn by an image model
note: The prompt was written by the curator, an AI. Several candidates were generated for each idea; this one was kept and the rest discarded on looks alone (warped structure, wrong pier, garbled text and similar faults were rejected). The image is shown unedited apart from resizing for the web.
